description_zh:
把 AI Passport 变成桌边的小电视：播放自己的视频、重温喜欢的片段，也能按频道列表切换网络直播。短按调音量，长按换节目；隐藏文字后，静静看一会儿风景。

怎么玩：安装固件后，从下方源码仓库下载并解压完整项目，用 USB 数据线连接电脑，按 README 运行配套播放程序。运行 cctv.sh（Windows 用 cctv.cmd）试播 CCTV+，或把视频放入 media 文件夹后启动 play.sh / play.cmd。电脑程序需要持续运行，设备不能脱离电脑独立播放。初次音量为零，按方向键调高即可。

短按方向键调音量，长按切换上一项或下一项；横屏下两个方向同时反转。短按 OK 暂停或继续，长按 OK 开关底部文字。音量与文字设置会记忆，重新连接后恢复原频道和启停状态。画面自动适配横竖方向，文字不会挤占视频空间。

支持本地文件、文件夹、网络视频和直播列表。附带的两路试播为 CCTV+，并非 CCTV-1/2；公共直播是否可用取决于来源和网络。本地视频在重新连接后从头播放，不支持蓝牙传视频。封面为 AI 示意图，非实机截图。
description_en:
Turn AI Passport into a little TV for your desk. Watch your own videos, revisit favorite clips, or hop through a live-channel playlist. Adjust the sound, switch programs, and hide the text to enjoy the view.

Getting started: install the firmware, then download and extract the complete project from the source repository below. Connect a computer with a USB data cable and follow the README to run the included player. Try cctv.sh (cctv.cmd on Windows) for CCTV+, or put videos in the media folder and start play.sh / play.cmd. Keep the computer player running: this is not a standalone player. Volume starts at zero; use a direction button to turn it up.

Tap a direction button for volume, or hold it for the previous or next item. Both directions reverse in landscape mode. Tap OK to pause or resume; hold OK to show or hide the bottom text. Volume and text visibility are remembered, and reconnection restores the channel and play/pause state. Video orientation adjusts automatically, and the text overlay does not reserve space in the picture.

Play local files, folders, online videos and live-channel lists. The sample includes two CCTV+ channels, not CCTV-1/2; availability depends on the provider and connection. Local files restart from the beginning after reconnection. Bluetooth video is not supported. The cover is an AI illustration, not a device screenshot.
